mechanism: Betamethasone may increase ganciclovir nephrotoxicity through additive renal effects and fluid retention; ganciclovir's myelosuppression may be potentiated by corticosteroid immunosuppression.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) regularly; assess for signs of myelosuppression; use lowest effective corticosteroid dose and consider alternative if prolonged therapy needed.
